name: プロデューサー
trans:
Yeah.
I've been looking at you the entire time.

name: プロデューサー
text:
楽しそうだな、美琴
こっちまで楽しくなるよ
trans:
You looked like you were having so much fun,
Mikoto. So much that it felt like it'd infect
everyone over here too.

name: 美琴
trans:
I see...
Glad to hear that.

name: プロデューサー
text:
ん？　自分でわからないのか？
楽しんでるって
trans:
Hm? Weren't you able to feel it by yourself?
That you were having fun?

name: 美琴
text:
最初は楽しんでるってわかっていたけど……
途中からは考えてもいないの
trans:
I knew that I was enjoying the moment at first,
but... I just stopped thinking about anything by
the middle of it.

name: 美琴
text: 何も考えられないくらい、楽しいんだと思う……
trans:
I think I enjoyed it so much that I couldn't think
about anything else anymore...

name: プロデューサー
text:
はは、そんなこと言っていたな
実現できたわけだ
trans:
Haha, that's what you said
before going up there, isn't it?
You've made your own wish come true.

name: 美琴
text: ……うん、でもまだ終わっていないから

name: 美琴
text: まだまだ……楽しんでくるね
trans:
So I'm going to...
keep on enjoying it much more.
